translations.web: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
translations.bsb: Many seek the favor of the prince, and everyone is a friend of the gift giver.
translations.kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
translations.asv: Many will entreat the favor of the liberal man; And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
